Our Story

Padmakshi

Padmakshi is a saree and ethnic wear brand made for women who love the grace of traditional Indian clothing.

Rich colours, gleaming zari borders and a modern sense of styling guide every saree we choose, so you can drape something beautiful for any occasion.

Choosing is simple: pick your saree, share your details and we confirm everything with you personally on WhatsApp.

Help

Frequently Asked Questions

How can I place an order?

Open a saree, choose the quantity and tap Order Now. Enter your name, mobile number and delivery address, review the summary, then confirm on WhatsApp.

How can I check saree availability?

Message Padmakshi on WhatsApp with the saree name and we will let you know.

How can I confirm my order?

Tapping “Confirm Order on WhatsApp” opens WhatsApp with your order details ready. Send the message to complete your order request.

Do you provide delivery?

Share your delivery address with your order and we will confirm delivery details with you on WhatsApp.

How do I contact Padmakshi?

Use the WhatsApp button in the Contact section below.
